body.email: optional; absent means legacy deployment owner

account.password_epoch: updated password revokes previous sessions and connector tokens

workspace.member_change_validation: role is required; explicit JSON null means removal; unknown fields and invalid roles are rejected with 422 without changing membership
workspace.invitation_validation: unknown fields are rejected with 422; missing or null email remains an intentional link invitation
workspace.concurrent_writes: account catalog writes and tutorial imports recheck current member role and project binding within their write transaction, before idempotency replay; a workspace share lock orders commits against member removal/downgrade

agent_network.credential: personal project connector, 8 hours, communications only
agent_network.agents: GET/POST /agents; registration requires connector and native_agent_id,name
agent_network.receipt_semantics: received only; no execution or acceptance authority
agent_network.visibility: shared with authorized project members; connector inbox restricted to owned connector agents
agent_network.renew: POST /integrations/{integration}/sessions; personal owner of an active connector only; new 8h token preserves agent ids and inbox; prior token remains valid until expiry or explicit revocation

pagination.next_cursor: last returned sequence for after reads
pagination.previous_cursor: first returned sequence for before reads; null on empty
pagination.has_more: exactly computed using one lookahead row; direction older for latest/before, newer for after
pagination.scope: connector and project permissions identical in every direction

agent_network.retry: current sender authorization required; identical accepted message returns original result even after recipient is revoked; changed content conflicts

tutorial.install: POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/tutorial/personal-site; Idempotency-Key required; empty project only; atomic DRAFT_ONLY
